CardDescription.DefaultText: A hand-bound book of hemp paper that records where and when the forest plants grow. Read it to look anything up.

CardHelpSection.DefaultText: Made from: six sheets of Hemp Paper and twine, from the Support tab. Uses: Choose Read to see where and when each plant can be found. The guide is not used up.

ActionDescription.DefaultText:
Where and when each plant of the forest turns up. Unless a line says otherwise, a plant is found by foraging from spring to autumn and never in winter.

Places
Oak woods: oak groves, thickets and clearings, Foraging Path, Oak Clearing, Misty Falls
Alder woods: alder groves, thickets and clearings, Alder Woods
Pine woods: pine groves, thickets and clearings, Pine Clearing, Highland Meadow
Clearings: other clearings, Oak Clearing, Pine Clearing, Highland Meadow
Pine meadows: pine meadows, Highland Meadow
North: the northern places above Grenfell Falls, Highland Meadow
River banks: river places, Lake Island, Misty Falls
Willow places: willow groves and thickets
Birch stands: 17 birch-tree places
Old-Growth Grove: west of Misty Falls, once this mod's six other places have been explored

Plants
Morel Mushroom: all year. Oak woods, alder woods, river banks, Highland Meadow, Old-Growth Grove.
Lion's Mane Mushroom: oak woods, alder woods.
King Oyster: all year. Oak woods, alder woods, pine woods.
Golden Oyster: all year. Oak woods, alder woods, pine woods.
Chanterelle: oak woods, alder woods, Highland Meadow, birch stands.
Reishi Mushroom: oak woods, alder woods, pine woods.
Giant Puffball: clearings, Foraging Path, Alder Woods.
Chicken of the Woods: willow places, oak woods, alder woods.
Black Trumpet: oak woods, alder woods, Highland Meadow.
Shiitake Mushroom: oak woods, alder woods, Primeval Woods, Highland Meadow.
Chaga: all year. Oak Clearing, Alder Woods, Pine Clearing, Highland Meadow, birch stands.
Death Cap (deadly): north, Foraging Path, Oak Clearing, Alder Woods, Pine Clearing.
Truffle: spring to autumn, rarely, by digging up mud at a river, and by foraging the Old-Growth Grove; in any season with Dig for Truffles at the vanilla oak and alder groves, thickets and clearings (this mod's own places do not have it).
Wild Ginseng: Primeval Woods, Lost Woods, Green Grove, Green Glade, Oaken Grove, Foraging Path, Oak Clearing, Alder Woods, Pine Clearing, Highland Meadow.
Ginger: river banks, willow places, Foraging Path, Oak Clearing, Alder Woods, Pine Clearing, Highland Meadow.
Yarrow: commonest in pine meadows. Other clearings, Foraging Path, Alder Woods.
Wolfsbane (poisonous): river banks.
Wild Flowers: clearings, pine meadows, river banks, Foraging Path, Alder Woods.
Dandelion: clearings, river banks, oak woods, alder woods.
Common Plantain: clearings, river banks, Foraging Path, Alder Woods, 13 of the birch stands.
Chamomile: pine meadows, clearings, Foraging Path, Alder Woods, 16 of the birch stands.
Blackcurrants: summer only. River banks, oak woods, alder woods, Highland Meadow, birch stands.
Redcurrants: summer only. Oak woods, alder woods, clearings other than pine meadows, 12 of the birch stands.
Lingonberries: summer and autumn. Pine meadows, pine woods, north, Foraging Path, Oak Clearing, Alder Woods.
Cloudberries: north, pine meadows, Foraging Path, Oak Clearing, Alder Woods, Pine Clearing, Old-Growth Grove.
Hemp Seeds and Hemp Plants: Primeval Woods, Lake Island. Seeds also come from clearing the ground in Primeval Woods.
Peanut Pods: oak woods, alder woods, clearings, pine woods.
Velvet Shank: winter only. Oak woods, alder woods, willow places, Foraging Path, Oak Clearing, Alder Woods.
Watercress: any place with a river.
Water Lily Rhizome: any place with a river.
Camas Bulb: spring and summer. Foraging Path, Highland Meadow.
Fiddleheads: spring only. Oak Clearing, Alder Woods.
Thistle Greens: spring and summer. Foraging Path, Highland Meadow.
Goosefoot Greens: spring and summer. Foraging Path, Oak Clearing.
Rhubarb: spring and summer. Foraging Path, Alder Woods.
Horseradish Root: spring and autumn. Alder Woods, Pine Clearing.
Mustard Seeds: summer and autumn. Foraging Path, Highland Meadow.
Chicory Root: summer and autumn. Foraging Path, Highland Meadow.
Mandrake Root: summer and autumn. Oak Clearing, Old-Growth Grove.
Turnroot Greens: not foraged. About half the times you harvest a mature turnroot field by hand, spring to autumn.
Crabapples: autumn only. Foraging Path, Oak Clearing.
Wild Pears: summer and autumn. Oak Clearing, Alder Woods.
Wild Plums: autumn only. Foraging Path, Pine Clearing.
Chestnuts: autumn only. Foraging Path, Oak Clearing.
Hazelnuts: autumn only. Foraging Path, Alder Woods.
Sloes: autumn only. Foraging Path, Highland Meadow.
Elderflowers: spring and summer. Foraging Path, Alder Woods.
Elderberries: autumn only. Foraging Path, Alder Woods.
Kale: Foraging Path, Highland Meadow.
Leek: Foraging Path, Alder Woods.
Carrot: Alder Woods, Highland Meadow.
Broad Beans: spring and summer. Alder Woods, Highland Meadow.
Hops: summer and autumn. Oak Clearing, Alder Woods.
Grapes: summer and autumn. Foraging Path, Oak Clearing.
Oats: summer and autumn. Foraging Path, Highland Meadow.
